name: Car Taxi City Driver Simulator VR

reviews.review_description:
its just level 1 ( drop the guy ) & level 2 ( drop the girl ) ,, and its repeated in a loop again , the same guy & the same girl again & again with the same map 

,, and the car is very slow

developer_response.body: Thank you for sharing your feedback. We’re sorry that the game experience did not meet your expectations. We appreciate your suggestions regarding additional levels, more varied locations, and vehicle speed. Your feedback is valuable to us, and we’ll consider it as we continue improving the game. We hope to provide you with a better experience in future updates!
